body.name: deterministic upper tuning objects
body.construction: \(K_n=\lfloor\log n/\log\log n\rfloor\), \(T_n=K_n/B_A\), \(\Gamma_n=\{\ell/(B_AK_n):|\ell|\le K_n^2\}\), \(\mathcal D_n=\Gamma_n^2\), \(\lambda_n=\log(48|\mathcal X||\mathcal D_n|/\alpha)\), \(H_n=\{M_e(n/\lambda_n)^{1/2}\}^{1/q_e}\), and \(M_n=2|\Gamma_n|+4\).
